application:authorization-model:model.decision: Neither app has any authorization (all routes open). Unified app: per-user ownership; one can(user, action, record) check used by every route and query; a user can only read or change their own books, ratings and lists. One role 'reader'; no admin role in v1.

application:rule:rating-scale.decision: Follow the code, not Shelfie's stale docs: integer 'stars' 1-5, checked in the API (reject non-integers and booleans) and by a DB CHECK. The documented 1-10 'score' is not built.

application:session:session.decision: Neither app has sessions (Shelfie reads a secret it never uses). Unified app: email + password accounts, password hashed with a slow KDF, server-side session row referenced by an http-only, SameSite=Lax, Secure (in production) cookie signed with SESSION_SECRET.

api:api-contract:export-format.decision: JSON export as the code does; CSV (documented only, never built) is not built; left as an open question for the user.

application:architecture:documented-serv.decision: Stale three-service / PostgreSQL docs are ignored; architecture chosen on this project's drivers in phase 5.

database:data-integrity:list-entries-and.decision: ReadingListItem primary key (list_id, book_id); PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; ON DELETE CASCADE from list and book; ownership checked on both.

database:data-integrity:rating-cardinali.decision: Rating unique (user_id, book_id); PUT upserts, DELETE clears; every write commits in a transaction; export shows the current rating.

database:duplicate-entity:book.decision: One Book entity merged from A:Book and B:Book: id, owner_id (new), title, author (from A, nullable), timestamps.

api:api-version:path-prefix.decision: Every endpoint under /api/v1; no compatibility shims for Shelfie's unversioned /api paths (no known clients).

application:configuration:undocumented-s.decision: Replaced by SESSION_SECRET, read in the config module, listed (name only) in .env.example, used to sign session cookies; startup fails with a clear message if unset outside development.

migration:book.decision: No source data is imported in this plan (whether shelfie.db or readr.db hold data is unknown). Step risk is low (adds author). Any future import is a separate migration needing its own approval.
